title: Fantasy Mountain Valley
description: A vast fantasy landscape at twilight featuring snow-capped purple mountains, a winding river with a stone bridge, a grand castle perched on a peak, and a foreground cliff with a wooden sign reading 'THE END'. Sheep graze on purple hills while a dragon flies in the sky near a crescent moon.
